title: The bank is sending a courier for your card
scenario: Someone calling from your bank's 'fraud team' says your card has been compromised. To protect you, they're sending a courier to collect the physical card within the hour, along with the PIN written on paper.

answers.A: Hand the card to the courier but keep the PIN only in your head.
answers.B: Hand over the card and PIN as instructed to stop the fraud.
answers.C: Hang up and call your bank using the number on the back of the card; banks never collect cards or PINs by courier.

explanation: No legitimate bank ever sends someone to your door to collect your card or PIN. This is courier fraud, and it moves fast precisely so you don't have time to check.
proTip: A bank protects a compromised card by freezing it - never by sending someone to collect it.
